exports.buildDashscopeImageRequest: (providerId, model, body) -> exact upstream body; throws status 400 before any network call

exports.dashscopeImageAccounting: success accounting: token counts, numeric usage receipt in meta, returned image units

auth.isolation: each adapter sends only the selected connection's key, and only to its own fixed origin
auth.region: providerSpecificData.region absent or global-sg; china-beijing and other values refused with 400 before send

accepted: size (WxH or W*H, sides 64..8192, sent as W*H)
image / image_url / imageUrls / image_urls (public https, at most 9, image-input models only)
refused: model outside the identity's allowlist or with another identity's prefix
non-https, private-host or data: input images

generate.body: { model, input: { messages: [{ role: user, content }] }, parameters? }
generate.answer: { output: { choices: [{ message: { content: [{ image }] } }] }, usage?, request_id? }

accounting.success: once per success: nativeUnits.images = returned public URLs; usage input/output/total_tokens recorded as tokens when reported; numeric usage receipt (incl. image_count, width, height) in meta.providerUsage; cost unknown
accounting.acceptedJob: submit-unknown: timeout, abort or disconnect after send, 5xx, foreign-origin answer; accepted: a 2xx that is unreadable or without a safe image. Never resent.
accounting.quota: 402, or 400/403 with code Arrearage / AccessDenied.Unpurchased -> 402 quotaExhausted on this connection; 429 -> rate limit with Retry-After
